item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: Religious parents and educators challenged California policies aimed at preventing schools from outing children.

item.title: In a first as president, Trump says he’ll attend the White House correspondents’ dinner
item.description: Trump skipped the dinner throughout his first term and also missed last year’s event.

item.title: Bits & Bites: When will restaurant patio season begin in Baltimore?
item.description: As the city's climate begins to flirt with outdoor-friendly weather, diners and chefs alike are eager to officially begin patio season.

item.title: Democrats’ newfound unity faces a test after US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: Some pro-Israel Democrats say they will not support a war powers vote to limit Trump.

item.title: Slutty Vegan founder Pinky Cole files for bankruptcy, is $1.4M in debt
item.description: Aisha “Pinky” Cole, the Baltimore native behind plant-based restaurant chain Slutty Vegan, has filed for bankruptcy, court records show.

item.title: Southern boys basketball eyes historic win after beating Glenelg, 67-40, in region semifinals
item.description: Southern boys basketball will host a region championship game Wednesday after Monday's semifinal win over Glenelg.

item.title: Ocean City clarifies hotel tax use for sports complex
item.description: Ocean City approved changes allowing hotel tax revenue to fund a proposed sports complex, even as the project remains without a site.

item.title: Former Terps standout Julian Reese makes NBA debut with Wizards
item.description: Just a couple of days after signing a two-way deal with Washington, Julian Reese made his NBA debut Monday against the Rockets.

item.title: Sweeping Anne Arundel signage bill altered, approaches deadline
item.description: Time is running out for the Anne Arundel County Council to vote on a bill that rebuilds its code for signage of all types, from yard sales to storefronts.

item.title: FOX45 News: Search is on for man police say pulled gun and assaulted a youth in Glen Burnie
item.description: A man accused of pointing what police believe was a gun at a group of juveniles inside a Glen Burnie pizza shop and assaulting one of them remained at large as Anne Arundel County Police asked the public for help identifying him.
